description: Source code for managing packet generation (pktgen) operations, including starting/stopping traffic, configuration, and status checks.

methods.name: pgctrl_command
methods.description: Sends control commands to pktgen via file interface.

methods.name: start_wifi_blast
methods.description: Forks a process to start pktgen traffic.

methods.name: onewifi_pktgen_is_running
methods.description: Checks if pktgen is currently running on the interface.

methods.name: pktgen_configure
methods.description: Configures pktgen parameters such as device, MAC address, packet size.

methods.name: onewifi_pktgen_start_wifi_blast
methods.description: Starts pktgen traffic if not already running.

methods.name: onewifi_pktgen_stop_wifi_blast
methods.description: Stops pktgen traffic and resets control.

methods.name: onewifi_pktgen_init
methods.description: Initializes pktgen support by checking control file existence.
